% Macros for the manuscript, input once after all packages.
% Notation and theorem environments are defined here; the numbers quoted in
% the running text are generated by code/run_all.py into tables/macros.tex.

\theoremstyle{plain}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{proposition}[theorem]{Proposition}
\theoremstyle{remark}
\newtheorem{remark}[theorem]{Remark}

\newcommand{\Cfit}{C_{\mathrm{fit}}}
\newcommand{\CW}{C_W}
\newcommand{\logX}{\log X}
\newcommand{\Xeff}{X_{\mathrm{eff}}}
\newcommand{\Etwo}{E_2}
\newcommand{\Ethree}{E_3}
\DeclareMathOperator{\li}{li}

% Every table, figure and number in the text is generated from the census.
% If the generated files are absent, stop with an actionable message.
\IfFileExists{tables/macros.tex}{}{%
  \PackageError{fgp}{%
    ^^J
    ================================================================^^J
    The generated tables, figures and numbers are missing.^^J
    Build them first, from the repository root:^^J
    \space\space\space\space make^^J
    or, without make:^^J
    \space\space\space\space python3 code/run_all.py data/fgp_layers.csv --out paper^^J
    ================================================================^^J
  }{Run the pipeline, then build the manuscript again.}%
}
\input{tables/macros}
